ko: SQUEAK. THAT MEANS OW.
SQUEAK SQUEAK. THAT MEANS TELL MY WIFE.
I HAVE FORTY KIDS. THEY WILL NOT NOTICE.
MY TAIL. NOT THE TAIL. ANYTHING BUT THE TAIL.
I SURVIVED THE PLAGUE. I DID NOT SURVIVE A FAMILY.
TELL THE RAT KING I DIED FOR CHEESE. THERE WAS NO CHEESE.
THERE IS NEVER ANY CHEESE.
I ATE A DIAPER THIS MORNING. I DESERVE THIS.
I HAVE BEEN FLUSHED. ONE MORE TIME.
SEND ME DOWN THE DRAIN. I KNOW THE WAY.
THE SEWER WILL REMEMBER ME. THE SEWER REMEMBERS EVERYTHING.
I SMELL LIKE THE SEWER. THAT IS MY COLOGNE.
MY WHISKERS ARE BENT. MY DIGNITY WAS NEVER STRAIGHT.
I AM TINY. HOW DID YOU EVEN HIT ME?
THE HITBOX IS SMALL. THE PAIN IS BIG.
I WAS ONE OF A DOZEN. NOW I AM ONE OF ELEVEN.
ELEVEN LEFT. THEY ALL OWE ME MONEY.
I CHEWED THROUGH A CABLE FOR THIS JOB.
I CHEWED THROUGH A WALL. I CHEWED THROUGH A CAR. I CANNOT CHEW THROUGH THIS.
MY TEETH NEVER STOP GROWING. MY LIFE DID.
SOMEBODY SAVE MY CRUST. I HID A CRUST BEHIND THE PIPE.
THE CRUST IS FOR MY CHILDREN. ALL NINETY OF THEM.
I WAS GOING TO RUN FOR RAT KING. THE ELECTION IS NEXT WEEK.
THE RAT KING IS INTERIM. EVERYTHING HERE IS INTERIM.
I GOT KICKED INTO A PUDDLE. I THINK IT IS A PUDDLE.
THIS IS NOT A PUDDLE.
I LANDED IN SOMETHING THAT LANDED HERE FIRST.
THE GECKOS WILL USE ME AS A NAPKIN.
I SAW A NINJA WITH A SHOE ON HIS HEAD. I KNEW IT WAS A BAD DAY.
I LIVED IN A BOOT ONCE. ON A NINJA HEAD. IT WAS ROOMY.
WHY IS EVERYTHING DOWN HERE SO WET.
I AM DAMP AND DEFEATED.
I SEE THE LIGHT. IT IS A MANHOLE COVER. IT IS CLOSING.
I AM GOING TO THE BIG SEWER IN THE SKY.
THE BIG SEWER IN THE SKY HAS UNLIMITED GARBAGE.
DO NOT FLUSH ME. I WANT A PROPER BURIAL. IN A TAKEOUT BOX.
MY FLEAS ARE LEAVING ME. EVEN MY FLEAS.
MY FLEAS HAVE FLEAS. THEY ARE ALSO LEAVING.
SQUEEEEEAK.
I WAS TRYING TO BE SCARY. I AM FOUR INCHES TALL.
FOUR INCHES IS PLENTY. MY WIFE SAYS SO. SHE IS A RAT.
TELL MY WIFE THE GARBAGE IS UNDER THE BRIDGE.
I HAD A FAMILY ONCE. I STILL DO. THEY ARE ALL HERE. OH NO.
I GOT STEPPED ON BY A SNEAKER. A STINKY SNEAKER.
DEATH BY SNEAKER. WHAT A WAY TO GO.
THAT FAMILY SMELLS WORSE THAN ME. RESPECT.
I ATE A BATTERY ONCE. I FELT AMAZING. I FEEL TERRIBLE NOW.
MY TAIL IS IN A KNOT. MY STOMACH IS IN A KNOT.
I HAVE A TINY BRAIN. IT IS TINY AND SCRAMBLED.
I CAN TASTE PURPLE.
RAT DOWN. RAT DOWN. EVERY RAT FOR HIMSELF.
I WAS THE BRAVE ONE. LOOK WHERE BRAVE GOT ME.
I WAS THE SNEAKY ONE. I SNUCK RIGHT INTO A FIST.
I WAS THE LARGE SEWER RAT. NOW I AM THE FLAT SEWER RAT.
UNUSUALLY LARGE. UNUSUALLY DEAD.
THE PIED PIPER WAS NICER THAN THIS.
I CHEWED ON A KID'S BALLOON ONCE. KARMA.
I TOOK A BITE OF YOUR SHOE. IT WAS WORTH IT.
YOUR TOES TASTE LIKE CORN CHIPS. THANK YOU.
MY EARS ARE RINGING. MY EARS ARE VERY THIN.
I HAVE BEEN PUNTED. LIKE A FOOTBALL. A HAIRY FOOTBALL.
I FLEW. I FLEW SO FAR. I LANDED IN SOUP.
IT IS NOT SOUP.
THE PIPES ARE PLAYING MY FUNERAL SONG. GLUG. GLUG.
I REGRET NOTHING. EXCEPT THE DIAPER.
MY WHOLE LIFE I WANTED TO BE A HAMSTER.
HAMSTERS GET WHEELS. HAMSTERS GET CAGES. I GET THIS.
BURY ME IN A PIZZA BOX. NO. A CEREAL BOX.
I WILL HAUNT YOUR PANTRY.
I WILL HAUNT YOUR BREAD. IT WILL ALWAYS HAVE ONE BITE.
MY CHEEK POUCH IS FULL OF COINS. TAKE THEM. NO. TAKE THEM.
I BIT A NINJA ONCE. HE TASTED LIKE FEET.
I THINK I BROKE MY TAIL. CAN YOU BREAK A TAIL? I DID.
MY LITTLE PAWS. LOOK AT MY LITTLE PAWS. THEY ARE SAD.
I PEED ON YOUR FOOT. SORRY. NOT SORRY. SORRY.
EVERYONE HATES US. THE FEELING IS MUTUAL. ALSO OW.
THE SEWER GATORS WILL HEAR OF THIS. THERE ARE NO SEWER GATORS. I HOPE.
I HAVE SEEN THINGS IN THESE PIPES. MOSTLY GOLDFISH.
THE GOLDFISH WERE NOT DEAD. THEY WERE ESCAPING.
THE MANHOLE WAS MY DOOR. YOU KNOCKED. I ANSWERED. BAD IDEA.
THAT WAS MY LAST LIFE. RATS DO NOT GET NINE. THAT IS CATS.
SQUEAK MEANS PLEASE STOP. SQUEAK SQUEAK MEANS PLEASE STOP NOW.
MY COUSIN LIVES IN A FANCY RESTAURANT. HE NEVER CALLS.
I HAVE BEEN TO THE TOP OF THE CITY. IN A GARBAGE BAG.
I GOT FLATTENED BY A FAMILY. AGAIN. WHY DO FAMILIES HATE US.
I WAS ONLY HERE FOR THE BAGEL.
THE BAGEL IS ROLLING AWAY. GOODBYE, BAGEL.
MY TINY HEART IS BEATING SO FAST.
THIS IS THE WORST DAY OF MY LIFE. MY LIFE IS TWO YEARS LONG.
I AM GOING TO SQUEAK ABOUT THIS IN THERAPY.
THE RAT KING WILL MAKE A STATEMENT. IT WILL BE A SQUEAK.
THIS IS WHY WE LIVE IN THE DARK.
TINY SCREAM.
I CRAWLED OUT OF A TOILET FOR THIS.
THE TOILET WAS NICER.
THE TOILET WAS SO MUCH NICER.
MY WHISKERS SAW THAT COMING. I DID NOT LISTEN.
I SHOULD HAVE STAYED IN THE WALLS.
I WAS GOING TO BE A MASCOT FOR A CHEESE COMPANY.
I SQUEAKED SO HARD I LOST MY VOICE. SQUEAK.
spawn: SQUEAK! THAT MEANS GET THEM!
WE ARE MANY! WE ARE SMALL! WE ARE STICKY!
THE RAT KING (INTERIM) COMMANDS YOU TO DROP YOUR SNACKS.
DROP THE SNACKS AND NOBODY GETS NIBBLED.
NIBBLE ATTACK!
WE HAVE TEETH. WE HAVE SO MANY TEETH.
I CAN SMELL YOUR LUNCH FROM THREE PIPES AWAY.
YOU STEPPED IN OUR DINNER.
THAT WAS OUR DINNER YOU WERE STANDING IN.
WE CRAWL OUT OF EVERYTHING ROUND. THEY SAID IT IN THE HOUSE RULES.
SWARM! SWARM! WAIT FOR STEVE! SWARM!
STEVE IS ALWAYS LATE.
WE ARE RATS. WE ARE PROUD. WE ARE DAMP.
THE SEWER IS OURS. YOU ARE STANDING IN OUR LIVING ROOM.
WIPE YOUR FEET. NO, DO NOT. WE LIKE IT DIRTY.
I BIT A TIRE ONCE. I WILL BITE YOUR ANKLE.
ANKLES! GO FOR THE ANKLES! WE CANNOT REACH ANYTHING ELSE!
WE ARE SHORT BUT WE ARE ANGRY.
THE UNUSUALLY LARGE ONE IS IN CHARGE. HE IS ALSO HUNGRY.
SQUEAK SQUEAK SQUEAK. THAT IS OUR BATTLE CRY. IT IS ALSO OUR LULLABY.
I HAVE BEEN WAITING IN THIS PIPE FOR A WEEK.
WE HEARD THERE WAS A FAMILY. FAMILIES DROP CRUMBS.
IS THAT A SANDWICH IN YOUR POCKET? IT IS NOW OURS.
WE CHEWED THROUGH THE SECURITY.
THE GECKOS ARE NOT HOME. WE ARE THE WELCOME COMMITTEE.
TODAY WE EAT LIKE KINGS. INTERIM KINGS.
HERE COME THE PITTER PATTERS.
WE WASHED OUR PAWS IN THE SEWER. THEY ARE SO MUCH WORSE NOW.
SMELL THAT? THAT IS VICTORY. AND ALSO THE PIPE.
WE NEVER STOP. WE NEVER SLEEP. WE NAP A LOT.
THE TWELVE OF US ARE ONE. THE ONE OF US IS STEVE.
FRESH TOES! FRESH TOES!
WE BRING DISEASES. AS A GIFT.
NO CHEESE? NO MERCY.
WE HAVE ROLLED IN EVERYTHING DOWN HERE. FEAR US.
DO NOT SCREAM. SCREAMING ATTRACTS MORE OF US.
THERE ARE ALWAYS MORE OF US.
I AM ONLY HERE BECAUSE MY FRIENDS ARE HERE.
I CAN FIT THROUGH A HOLE THE SIZE OF A COIN. WATCH ME FIT THROUGH YOUR DEFENSE.
THE PIPES ARE SINGING. THEY SING OF SNACKS.
